_comment: Single source of truth for all frameworks. Add a new entry here + create a folder with index.html at the repo root. access: free | course | client · product: optional {name, price, url} for the storefront.

frameworks.title: LEVER
frameworks.subtitle: Align the goal. Expose the friction. Sequence the fix.
frameworks.summary: The consulting method for operations businesses that have bought AI and can't prove it worked. Goal Ladder → Decision Blueprint → Leverage Equation. Live calculator. Diagnostic £32,000.

frameworks.title: RECALL
frameworks.subtitle: Ask first. Score the corpus. Earn the right to build.
frameworks.summary: The other half of AI consulting: making a company's documents answerable. Question Ledger → Corpus Condition Index → Answerability Equation with a trust discount. Diagnostic £34,000.

frameworks.title: STAKE
frameworks.subtitle: I build it. I run it. You sell it.
frameworks.summary: The partnership method for a business that owns a vertical and needs a product it can't build. Royalty + service fee priced from a Motion Ledger; carry a stream only if RQ ≥ 4. Live calculator.

frameworks.title: REWIRED
frameworks.subtitle: Rebuilding belief systems for AI-native operators
frameworks.summary: A framework for rewiring the cognitive defaults that hold operators back from building AI-native businesses. Belief audit → identity reframe → action protocol.

frameworks.title: FLYWHEEL
frameworks.subtitle: Compounding leverage in AI-native businesses
frameworks.summary: How to architect a self-reinforcing loop where every action compounds the next. The mechanics behind AI-native businesses that scale without linear effort.

frameworks.title: The Rediscovery Canvas
frameworks.subtitle: A diagnostic for finding your edge after a transition
frameworks.summary: A structured canvas for operators in transition — between roles, industries, or identities. Maps assets, edges, and unfair advantages onto a single page.

frameworks.title: TeamScale
frameworks.subtitle: Scaling teams without losing the founding signal
frameworks.summary: An operating model for scaling teams from 5 to 50 without diluting the founding signal. Roles, rituals, and reporting structures that preserve velocity.

frameworks.title: Vibecoding
frameworks.subtitle: Shipping production code with AI as your co-pilot
frameworks.summary: An interactive course for non-engineers shipping real software with AI. From prompt to pull request — the workflow founders actually use.

frameworks.title: Sixty people, one bottleneck
frameworks.subtitle: Language Kids World, Houston — AI automations and a product business
frameworks.summary: Ten full-time staff, fifty contract teachers, one founder as the critical path. 92% less curriculum-development time, 10–15 working weeks a year returned, two product revenue lines created.
